fields.Name: T141 - Integrations Activity Log
fields.Description: Verifies the Activity section of the Integrations app renders the activity/run log view (rows or empty-state) without errors.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Integrations application. To reach it, open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and SCROLL the full list (it is long) to find 'Integrations'; if it is not in the switcher, try the application cards on the Home page, or the 'Configure Apps' option to add/open it. In Integrations, open the Activity section and verify the activity/run log renders (rows or empty-state), no crash. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Integrations app is active and the Activity section is displayed
The activity/run log view shows log or run rows, or a clean empty-state placeholder
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
